patterns.usage_note: Names an emotion or an overdone action pushed too far, with the result, usually unwelcome or extreme, following: 娘を心配するあまりに, 勝ちを急ぐあまりに. It attaches to a plain non-past verb, or to a noun of feeling through の (緊張のあまりに), and the に is optional. Distinct from the ordinary adverb あまり(に) "(not) very; excessively", which modifies a predicate directly. The tone is narrative.

examples.ruby: 娘[むすめ]を心配[しんぱい]するあまりに、母[はは]は毎晩[まいばん]電話[でんわ]をかけた。
examples.english: So consumed with worry for her daughter, the mother phoned every single night.

examples.ruby: 緊張[きんちょう]のあまりに、自分[じぶん]の名前[なまえ]を言[い]い間違[まちが]えた。
examples.english: I was so keyed up that I got my own name wrong.

examples.ruby: 勝[か]ちを急[いそ]ぐあまりに、監督[かんとく]は守[まも]りをおろそかにした。
examples.english: In his rush for the win, the coach let the defence slide.
